documentation.rule: Current code and reproducible byte/runtime evidence override historical chat summaries.

idleHpRegeneration.scope: Exactly 12 unit AI scripts; each must contain exactly one recognized s_addLP amount site.
idleHpRegeneration.intervalSource: SYSTEM/cl_script.ini LPIncIdle remains at the original 15000 ms.
idleHpRegeneration.behavior: Automatic HP regeneration while the unit is idle; decompilation shows no food-resource read or deduction on this path.

teamDat.patchBehavior: Only teamdata column 4 is loaded as the per-team limit; maxteamobjgenerell is preserved.

completedJobAutoRecycleFlag.behavior: Let the engine free completed military reinforcement jobs so the 20 per-team slots can be reused indefinitely.

MilitaryCreateUnitJob.reinforcementPollingRejectedFastReason: Runtime testing showed computer respawns could stop; this state is accepted only for migration back to 5-10 seconds.
MilitaryCreateUnitJob.actionLoopDelayUltimateBehavior: Accelerate all six scheduler delay sites. Indexes 0-2 are inner raider timers; indexes 3-5 initialize and refresh the outer scheduler that gates the dispatcher calling the settlement and military-reinforcement spawners. The prior first-three-only state is accepted for migration because it left AI arrival checks at 60-240 second intervals.

militaryReinforcementUnitThreshold.meaning: s_searchTeamUnits(team) threshold in the military-reinforcement spawner; not an AI-player or party-count limit.

reinforcementRetreatQuota.meaning: Set v56[party] to zero so the complete type-5 reinforcement party is handed to the village instead of retreating.
reinforcementRetreatQuota.coupling: Must be applied and restored atomically with militaryReinforcementUnitThreshold=40; the rejected threshold-8 plus quota-0 combination stopped later arrivals.

settlementSpawnerProbabilities.singlePlayerBound: The occupied mask reserves player team 0; pickTeam selects only unoccupied CPU teams 1-7, so at most seven computer opponents coexist and a defeated team becomes eligible again after its party slot is deleted.

settlementCountLimit.meaning: At new-game initialization, s_randRange(upperBound, lowerBound) is stored in v70 as the live type-1 settlement cap. M6 fixes it at 3 so the separate type-4 military settlement can remain the fourth settled opponent without starving military/attack parties of CPU-team slots. Existing saves retain their already initialized v70 value.

activeAiLimitBypass.reason: The unbounded dispatch can exhaust the 20 NPC-job slots available per team and stop later respawns.
activeAiLimitBypass.migration: Always restore the original gate words.

PartyRetreatDeadlines.meaning: Per-party-handler 'v61[party] := s_getTime() + N' retreat/cleanup fallback deadlines. DELETE_PARTY can be reached when handler cleanup conditions complete or when the fallback expires. Settled-party states 51/52 must be allowed to wait for old-village and palisade teardown before the team slot is reused.
signatureExclusions: Initial-arrival timeout after party creation (same prefix, no word 44 before the array write; decompressed 0x07F24; must stay 600000 or arrivals break).
Military reinforcement wait (same shape, followed by pushlit 34 = CIVRECREATE_WAIT; decompressed 0x178E0; handled by MilitaryCreateUnitJob.respawnDelay).
PartyRetreatDeadlines.history: 0x17F38 was previously misclassified as a village-defeat respawn timer. A later all-six-at-5000 build forced settled parties through DELETE_PARTY before old-village cleanup completed; ESAVE_000 on 2026-07-03 showed team 3 active with 71 stale village records and the old base coordinate (1632,5792).
PartyRetreatDeadlines.migration: Previous enabled states with one, none, or all six deadlines at 60000 ms are accepted as legacy-enabled and migrated to four accelerated non-settlement sites plus two protected settlement-cleanup sites.

VillageObjectCleanupCadence.meaning: After the main building dies, the leaving-village loop processes one building or palisade, waits for its confirmation, then yields for this cadence before processing the next object. The patch accelerates the confirmed loop instead of bypassing village cleanup.
VillageObjectCleanupCadence.scopeWarning: ak_haupthaus is global, so this also accelerates cleanup after a player main building dies; normal live-village production cadence is unchanged.
VillageObjectCleanupCadence.migration: An otherwise enabled AI Ultimate state with the original 1500-ms value is accepted as legacy-enabled and patched to 100 ms on the next Apply.

DeadPartyDebounceTicks.meaning: Consecutive no-living-members ticks required before a settled party whose village, leader, and civilians are all gone enters the retreat/cleanup chain (Siedler handler).

DefeatRecoveryChain.meaning: How a defeated endless AI team returns: the settled party's IDLE state detects the missing village center, then enters RETREAT after DeadPartyDebounceTicks. States 51/52 wait for the sequential village/palisade cleanup protocol or their fallback deadline, then use the vanilla DELETE_PARTY (256) terminal state. DELETE_TEAM (257) is unsafe here because it can remove the acknowledgement recipient while ak_haupthaus.bci is waiting, freezing the simulation loop.

settledTerminalCleanup.scope: Mandatory R0 migration for the two settled-party handlers; P15 is no longer user-toggleable M3 behavior.
settledTerminalCleanup.reason: The previous DELETE_TEAM patch tried to clear stale team state, but it could race the one-message/one-acknowledgement teardown protocol in ak_haupthaus.bci. P15 now detects all-257 and mixed 256/257 as Legacy and restores both sites to DELETE_PARTY.

notPatched: ak_npc.bci: reactivation is built-in (village exists && !NPCActive -> state 1 -> s_setNPCActive(team, 1)); no changes needed.
netGame-gated defeat handler at 0x1AA0C (mask clears + voice announcements) is a multiplayer human-slot recycler, not part of the AI respawn path.

RuntimeIncident20260703.resolution: Restored all five live scripts from a clean baseline, re-applied, and statically verified the full target state. The old save remains unchanged and is not valid runtime evidence for the repaired scripts.
RuntimeIncident20260703.roundTripWarning: Self decompress-compress-decompress equality can reproduce an already-invalid payload and is not game-compatibility proof.
requiredRecovery: Restore ENDL_000 through ENDL_004 ak_level.bci from a known-clean original baseline.
Decompress and verify the complete expected signature and target-value set in all five maps.
Start a fresh endless game for runtime acceptance; never rewrite saved CLAK/scr.dat.

evidence.observedBehavior: The team resettled before its old palisades and village registry cleared, so villagers continued targeting the old village location.

RuntimeIncident20260703VillageCleanup.rootCause: The prior AI Ultimate target shortened both settled-party state-51/52 fallback deadlines to 5000 ms, allowing the timeout path to force DELETE_PARTY before engine village cleanup completed.
RuntimeIncident20260703VillageCleanup.fix: Keep settled-handler offsets 0x10700 and 0x160EC at 600000 ms; accelerate only the four non-settlement deadlines. Recognize the prior all-six-at-5000 state as legacy-enabled and migrate it on Apply.
RuntimeIncident20260703VillageCleanup.acceptance: Start a fresh endless game, defeat a settlement AI for multiple cycles, and confirm old walls and village records clear before each respawn. Never rewrite the embedded save script.

evidence.dispatcherEvidence: The saved ak_level task stack was returning through the outer dispatcher after the settlement spawner had run, but no party survived creation.

RuntimeIncident20260704FullExtinction.rootCause: The previous P15 DELETE_TEAM (257) transition could delete a settled team during ak_haupthaus.bci's sequential village teardown, after a cleanup message was sent but before its acknowledgement returned. The waiter could then remain blocked indefinitely, freezing the simulation without crashing the process.
RuntimeIncident20260704FullExtinction.fix: P15 is moved from M3 to mandatory R0 and restores both settled-handler terminal transitions to the engine-proven DELETE_PARTY (256) path. Existing all-257 and mixed installations are recognized as Legacy and migrated.
RuntimeIncident20260704FullExtinction.compatibility: Existing saves embed ak_level.bci and are not rewritten. Re-apply the modifier so the live map scripts are migrated, then use a fresh endless game for runtime acceptance; a save already frozen in a blocked script state is not guaranteed recoverable.

villageEconomy.scope: The global ak_npc/ak_produktion edits are always restored because they stop player production; the independently verified battle-formation changes remain enabled under AI Ultimate.

villageBuildRangeRedFrame.legacyFourSiteRuntimeResult: No visible build range or red dashed frame change was observed after all four candidate sites were patched.

villageBuildRangeRedFrame.playerPathResult: 00536820 is directly called by 005367c0 and 00544fd0; player previews 0044f4b0 and 0044f7b0 do not call it. The logical pair is not the general player construction-range gate.
